title: Five Minutes Flat
subject: a woman training on her living-room rug to hold a plank for five full minutes before her fiftieth birthday, counting on the oven clock while her husband reads the seconds out loud
caption: UK happy hardcore, mid-90s Hixxy and Bang Face style. Pounding 4x4 kick, hoover synth stabs, bright rave piano chords, rolling off-beat bass. Bright 90s rave sheen with big piano reverb and a crisp modern master. Female soprano, clearly sung euphoric diva melody. 170 BPM, F major. Euphoric, stubborn, funny. No trap, no autotune drift, no dubstep, no rapped lines, no slow ballad sections.
lyrics:
[Intro - rave piano, hoover stab]

[Verse 1]
Elbows on the living-room rug
Toes on the edge of the mat
The oven clock says four past eight
I've got five minutes flat

[Pre-Chorus]
You read the seconds off your watch
You sound like a radio

[Chorus]
Five minutes flat, I'm nearly fifty
Shaking like a garden chair
Hold on, hold on, the kettle's whistling
I'm not getting up from here

[Verse 2]
In March I lasted forty seconds
In June I made it three
The cat walked under like I'm a bridge
And sat down under me

[Pre-Chorus]
Four fifty-eight, four fifty-nine
You're standing on the chair

[Chorus]
Five minutes flat, I'm nearly fifty
And I'm lying on the floor
You're cheering like I scored a goal
Now get the candles from the drawer

[Outro - piano breakdown, kick returns]
